summary: November 19, 2025 RPM installer fixes: EE image upload failing without an automation hub node, and gateway logs in /var/log/ansible-automation-platform/gateway split into control-plane-supervisor.log, control-plane.log, gateway.log, uwsgi.log and envoy.log.
questions: Where are platform gateway logs on RPM installs?
What is in control-plane.log versus gateway.log?
RPM installer fails uploading execution environment images without hub
Where is the envoy log for platform gateway?

answer_card.title: Platform gateway log files (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
In `/var/log/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/` (since Nov 19, 2025, AAP-30549):

- `control-plane-supervisor.log`: `supervisorctl` messages about the control plane (new)
- `control-plane.log`: Django logs for the control plane (new, split from gateway.log)
- `gateway.log`: Django logs for gateway
- `uwsgi.log`: uWSGI logs for gateway (new)
- `envoy.log`: the proxy log (unchanged)
